career_ladder.note: Constables (Civil Police) and Sepoys (Odisha Special Armed Police - OSAP / India Reserve Battalions) are recruited through the State Selection Board / Odisha Police Recruitment Board (OPRB). Career progression is governed by the Odisha Police Service Regulations and Police Manual based on departmental seniority, qualifying examinations, and field performance.

steps.source_label: Odisha Police Recruitment Rules for Constables and Sepoys

steps.designation: Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP, OPS Group A)
steps.source_label: Odisha Police Service (OPS) Cadre Promotion Rules

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to the rank of Constable / Sepoy is conducted in multiple stages: a Computer Based Recruitment Examination (CBRE), followed by Physical Standard Measurement (PSM) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET), concluding with Document Verification, optional Driving Trade Test, and Medical Examination.

stages.stage_name: Stage I: Computer Based Recruitment Examination (CBRE)
stages.source_label: Odisha Police State Selection Board Constable Recruitment Notification

papers.paper_name: CBRE Written Test (Odia Language 15 Q, English Language 15 Q, Arithmetic 20 Q, General Knowledge & Current Affairs 25 Q, Situational Awareness & Reasoning 15 Q, Basic Computer Knowledge 10 Q)
papers.negative_marking: 0.25 marks deducted per incorrect answer (1/4th penalty)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying marks: 35% for SC/ST, 40% for General and SEBC candidates

stages.stage_name: Stage II: Physical Standard Measurement (PSM) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
stages.source_label: Odisha Police Physical Standards and Physical Efficiency Regulations

papers.paper_name: PSM & PET (Run: Men 1.6 km in 6m 30s, Women 1.6 km in 8m 30s; Long Jump: Men 3.66m, Women 2.75m; Height: Men UR 168 cm, SC/ST 163 cm, Women UR 158 cm, SC/ST 153 cm)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying in nature; mandatory clearance of physical measurements, timed run, and broad jump

stages.stage_name: Stage III: Document Verification, Driving Trade Test & Medical Examination
stages.source_label: Odisha Police Selection and Medical Assessment Guidelines

papers.paper_name: Document Verification, Optional Driving Assessment (up to 5 bonus marks for valid HMV/LMV licence), and Comprehensive Medical Fitness Examination
papers.qualifying_threshold: Verification of educational and character antecedents; medical fitness clearance

financial_package.note: Constables and Sepoys in Odisha Police receive compensation under Pay Matrix Level 4 of the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017 (Pay Scale ₹19,900 - ₹63,200 with entry basic pay of ₹19,900). Police personnel also receive statutory police allowances including ration allowance, uniform allowance, and risk/hardship allowance for armed battalion postings.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017, Finance Department, Government of Odisha
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated on entry basic pay of ₹19,900 + 58% Dearness Allowance (₹11,542) + House Rent Allowance (9% to 18%: ₹1,791 to ₹3,582) + Odisha Police Ration Allowance (₹1,500 - ₹2,000) + Kit Maintenance / Uniform Allowance (~₹800) + Medical Allowance (₹500). Deductions include 10% NPS (Basic + DA = ₹3,144), Professional Tax (₹200), and Police Welfare Fund / GIS (~₹300).
official_perks: Government police barrack accommodation or family quarters, or House Rent Allowance (HRA at 9% to 18%)
Monthly Police Ration Allowance / Diet Allowance sanctioned by Home Department
Annual uniform allowance and kit maintenance allowance
Free medical care in Police Hospital and reimbursement under Odisha Government Servants' Medical Attendance Rules
Dearness Allowance (DA) indexed to state government revisions
Contributory pension coverage under New Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% state government matching contribution
Special hardship allowance / tactical duty allowance for OSAP/IRB deployments in anti-Naxalite operations
